what: Mean entropy of the masked operator distribution P(o|F_t) as a function of decision step t, split into items the final checkpoint solved exactly (certified) and items it failed. Bands are +/-1 s.e.m., n is the number of frames at that step; the dashed line is each group's overall mean.
one_line_reading: Every decision before step 4 is essentially deterministic (entropy < 1e-3 nats), and steps 4-6 are the only ones that carry any uncertainty. There the two groups separate sharply: at t=4 the failed items decide at 0.191 nats against 0.027 for the certified ones (7x). Both statements hold at once -- the model is measurably less certain at the step where it goes wrong, yet its top-1 probability there is still 0.918, so the mistake is also 'confidently wrong'.
method: entropy of softmax(step_logits + mask) with mask = legal operator indices + END, i.e. exactly the distribution gen34_eval.walk_chain decides with; frames grouped by item outcome, averaged per step index.
caveats: the failed group has only 27 items, so late-step points rest on a few frames and their s.e.m. bands are correspondingly wide.
the step axis is unbounded for failures: an item that stopped early has no frames at high t, so the per-step n differs between groups (annotated).
'certified' here is exact operator-chain match, which coincides with Lean certification on this checkpoint (191/218).
